otherMissingInputs.target: Agriculture supply, domestic use and export partners
otherMissingInputs.reason: Existing verified 2024 FAOSTAT QCL rows cover production/headcounts only. A comparable supply balance needs imports and stocks with matching product/year, and bilateral destinations need partner trade rows. Neither is in the adopted corpus. Food use is not inferred as production minus exports. No full numeric supply/use/partner table is claimed.

Adopted Natural Earth 1:10m cartographic paths improve visual traceability but do not certify hydrological routing, river discharge or scientifically defined mainstem. No invented connecting segments or flow arrows.
